name: Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd
tagline: Weak trailing returns but a real, trusted-tracked launch-driven inflection in an undersupplied Lucknow real-estate market -- unconfirmed
business_overview: Eldeco Housing is a Lucknow-focused real-estate developer with a project pipeline aimed at capturing an undersupplied local housing market; management has guided FY26 as a major launch year.
fundamentals_narrative: Trailing 5yr revenue growth (0.74%) and ROCE/ROE (under 9%/7%) are weak on average, but the most recent FY26 print shows a real 22.3% revenue jump -- consistent with a launch-driven inflection rather than a trailing-average story.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 58 posts (single batch, spanning 2017-Jan 2026, no escalation needed). harsh.beria93 (trusted) has tracked this stock with unusual consistency since 2022 -- concall notes across at least 8 quarters -- reporting pre-sales growing from 2.5 lakh sq.ft (FY21) to 7 lakh sq.ft (FY22), an undersupplied Lucknow market with 'less than 1 year supply,' and, as of the most recent post (Jan 2026), muted recent margins but explicit management guidance for a 'sharp improvement' in H2FY26 margins after a big FY26 launch year (Rs 400 Cr presales guidance, per Mar 2025 notes).
community_signal: harsh.beria93 (trusted, elevated) is the dominant voice in this thread, with 8+ concall-note posts since 2022 tracking the same launch-pipeline thesis consistently through to Jan 2026 -- the most sustained single-tracker coverage found in this batch.

trusted_signals.note: Margins have been muted in recent quarters, but management guides for a sharp improvement in H2FY26.
FY26 expected to be a big launch year, with presales guidance of Rs 400 Cr; land aggregation finishing up.

bse_notes: Not independently checked. A 2020 community post flagged rising royalty payouts to a privately-owned related entity (ELDECO Infra) as a minor governance watch-item; no update on this since.
bull_case: Real recent-quarter inflection: FY26 revenue growth of 22.3% against a weak 0.74% 5yr trailing average
Consistent multi-year trusted-tracker coverage (harsh.beria93) corroborates an undersupplied Lucknow market and a specific FY26 launch-driven presales ramp (Rs 400 Cr guidance)
Explicit management guidance for H2FY26 margin improvement, tracked as recently as Jan 2026
bear_case: Trailing ROCE/ROE (under 9%/7%) are weak -- the quality gate is not yet cleared, only guided to improve
The margin-improvement and presales guidance are management projections, not yet realized in reported numbers as of the last tracked post
Single-city (Lucknow) concentration; small free float / thin trading history noted by early posters
Minor, unresolved 2020-era related-party royalty-payout concern to a privately-owned promoter entity
verdict_headline: Weak trailing average, but a specific, trusted-tracked launch catalyst is exactly the recent-inflection pattern this thesis looks for -- unconfirmed
verdict_reasoning: Per this project's own rule for small-caps, a weak multi-year average should not hide a real recent-quarter inflection when a credible, specific catalyst exists -- here that catalyst is a management-guided FY26 launch year with Rs 400 Cr presales and H2FY26 margin recovery, corroborated by a trusted tracker across multiple quarters
Conviction stays Low because the margin recovery is still guidance, not yet delivered in reported numbers

four_box.note: Undersupplied Lucknow real-estate market is real but single-city concentration limits the structural case — tailwind weak; FY26 revenue +22.3% vs a weak 0.74% 5yr trailing average, with Rs400cr presales guidance, supports tam via the recent-inflection rule; no explicit moat for a single-city developer — no; ROCE/ROE (under 9%/7%) remain weak and margin-improvement is still guidance not delivered — valuation weak.
